apps.localizedDescription:
Gotchi Galaxy:

A pixel-art pocket pet you raise, breed and take to far-away planets. Free, no account, no ads.

Choose your way to play:

• Mac (the full game, plays with friends on the same Wi-Fi).

• Unzip it and drag Gotchi Galaxy to Applications.

Android (the full game, plays with friends on the same Wi-Fi).

• Android asks to allow installs from this source: say yes once.
• New versions are offered inside the game, in Settings.

iPhone app through TestFlight (the full game, plays with friends on the same Wi-Fi).

• Install Apple's TestFlight app from the App Store.
• On your iPhone, open the Gotchi Galaxy invite, tap Accept, then Install.
• New versions arrive in TestFlight; it offers each one.

versions.localizedDescription:
• The garden grows to two screens, with an orchard of fruit trees to plant, water and pick.
• Sell fruit to Sesame, or tie a Fruit Basket to give.
• A new garden set: the Orchard Picnic.
• Five thinking games for young players: Constellations, Pattern Train, Fuel Line, Pet Cafe and Market Day.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Gotchi Galaxy joins and hosts islands on your Wi-Fi so your pet can visit, trade and breed with friends nearby.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Gotchi Galaxy counts your steps today when you turn on Walk with me, so your pet's next trip comes home sooner. The count stays on your phone.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Gotchi Galaxy can save a picture of your pet's diary to your photos when you choose Save Image.
